maria (partnerships): Quick sync — proposed mini-project: automated demo env snapshots for partner field teams (Snowflake / Databricks / Qdrant). One command to spin up a sanitized snapshot + ephemeral creds + preview link. Primary goals: reproducible demo, no PII leakage, <48h TTL. Need owners for infra, sanitizer, docs, security review, and marketplace touchpoint.

aj (eng): Sounds great. We already have basic snapshot tooling in infra but no sanitizer step. I can add sanitizer + TTL integration. ETA: 1 week for prototype. Need guidance on KMS/oidc flows.

ellie (field-eng): This will save hours. Requirements from field: sample dataset <= 5GB, anonymize names/emails/ssn, keep query patterns representative so performance calls are realistic. Also want an auto-generated notebook that shows the 3 demo paths (search, embeddings, SQL).

samir (eng-ml): For vector DB snapshots — include metadata + vectors but we should avoid shipping model keys or proprietary embeddings. Options: (a) include precalc embeddings (sanitized), or (b) include raw text and compute embeddings on-demand with a small open model. Leaning (b) for safety.

ben (solutions): One ops ask: provide a terraform snippet so partners or field can spin the demo in their cloud account. Also want a marketplace demo image reference so marketing can link to it.

maria (partnerships): Security constraint: no long-lived creds in the snapshot. Plan: ephemeral OIDC + short-lived tokens (48h). @deploy-bot can provision preview role and return a link.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created ephemeral-preview role 'partner-demo-1765439999', expires in 48h — preview URL: https://previews.redwood.ai/demo/1765439999 (token in vault)

aj (eng): Proposed CLI for infra (will add in PR):
```
./scripts/create-demo-snapshot \n  --source prod \n  --size-limit 5G \n  --sanitize pii \n  --embed-mode on-demand \n  --ttl 48h
```
I'll wire up KMS encrypt + rotate and ensure logs are scrubbed.

ellie (field-eng): Docs checklist I'll own: 1) how to run snapshot 2) smoke queries to validate 3) latency/throughput quick tests 4) how to revoke preview early. Will include a pre-demo checklist.

sophia (security): sophia (security): I can take the sanitizer policy review. Requirements: deterministic PII redaction (names->randomized tokens), remove email/phone/SSN patterns, strip any API keys. Also want a small proof report showing sanitized rows sample. Can review by Thu if you post sanitizer spec.

samir (eng-ml): Also: telemetry tags for these demo runs: add tag demo.partner and capture avg latency + token count so we can retro on how representative the demo is.

ben (solutions): Marketing question — do we want a soft mention in the marketplace release? If so, timeline matters. If security review lands Thu, and prototype Wed, we could have a partner dry-run Fri and a short marketplace blurb the following week.

maria (partnerships): Timeline proposal: prototype by next Wed (1766000000-ish), security review Thu, field dry-run Fri. Owners: infra=aj, sanitizer=aj+samir, docs=ellie, security=sophia, marketplace=ben. Any blockers?

ellie (field-eng): No blockers from field. I'll schedule a dry-run slot and invite partner FE.

aj (eng): I'll open an infra PR today and link it. Will flag where we need product/legal signoff for sample datasets.

aj (eng): PR -> https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1267 (draft)

tina (partner-snow): tina (partner-snow): this approach looks good from our side. We prefer on-demand embeddings to avoid sharing compute artifacts. Happy to join dry-run.

maria (partnerships): Great — owners assigned. Quick security note: please ensure sanitizer has a deterministic salt so field demos are reproducible but non-reversible. :thumbsup:

sophia (security): noted. I'll provide a sanitizer checklist and template report.

maria (partnerships): Next steps: aj to open PR + CI job that runs sanitizer tests; ellie to draft demo checklist + example notebook; sophia to post sanitizer policy; ben to draft marketplace blurb. We'll reconvene here mid-week for status. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
